script.problem: It has 6 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: “That's a long walk home” adds a distance and destination the text does not give. Hirah returns to Judah, but the passage does not say he walks home.
“Nobody at Enaim has seen her” goes beyond what the men say. They say no shrine prostitute has been there; the text does not say nobody saw Tamar.
